facts.statement: Renata 一行人四处寻找失踪的 Star：在码头打听、去她有时接客的破旅馆、打电话给新泽西的家人（家人并未断绝关系但也不真正容忍她，且已数周没有她的消息），最后去第九分局，警察只是大笑。
facts.anchor: we went to the Ninth Precinct, and they just laughed and laughed.

facts.statement: 夜里 Renata 主持守夜祈祷；Bianca 和她的女伴们过来念玫瑰经，求 Star 若不能回家也能上天堂。
facts.anchor: Bianca and her girls came over to pray the rosary

facts.statement: Renata 挨个打电话问遍了市中心的医院，清单上最后一家是 St. Vincent’s；她先拨总机被转到急诊室（ER），但没人能告诉她任何消息。
facts.anchor: I went through all the hospitals downtown

facts.statement: Renata 手捏写着 Claude 护士站号码的纸条在厨房里踱步煎熬了两分钟，然后拨了过去；接电话的正是 Claude，她问 Renata 需要什么帮助。
facts.anchor: pacing the kitchen with the scrap of paper in my hand

facts.statement: Claude 说七楼有一个符合 Renata 朋友描述的伤者：情况稳定但被打得很惨，身份无法确认，还无法开口说话。
facts.anchor: We have someone who fits your friend’s description on seven.

facts.statement: Renata 追问为何那人不在急诊室，Claude 说曾在那里、后被转到七楼，并问 Renata 能否在她下班前赶到医院。
facts.anchor: Can you get here before my shift ends?

facts.statement: Renata 答应后挂断，随即打电话给 Bianca，告以 “Star 在 St. Vincent’s”、人在七楼；Bianca 说二十分钟、甚至十分钟内坐出租车赶到会合。
facts.anchor: I’ll meet you there in twenty. In ten; I’ll get a cab, I don’t care.

facts.statement: Renata 出门时 Leon 已在外等候（她完全忘了约好去看 Kurt 的展览）；Leon 起初说 “I can’t go there”，最后还是挽起她的手臂、一起往西走去医院。
facts.anchor: But he put his arm in mine and marched us west anyway.

relations.relation: 叙述者 Renata 的挚友，失踪者；被怀疑即七楼那名被打伤、无法辨认的女子
Renata 的朋友；带女伴们来守夜念玫瑰经，得知消息后打车赶往医院与 Renata 会合
relations.anchor: Bianca and her girls came over to pray the rosary

relations.relation: St. Vincent’s 护士站的护士；曾把护士站电话给 Renata，电话中向她透露七楼伤者的情况
relations.anchor: Claude had given me the phone number of her nursing station

relations.relation: Renata 的朋友；在外等她一起去看 Kurt 的展，抗拒去医院但最终陪她同往
relations.anchor: Leon was waiting for me outside

relations.relation: 办展的艺术家朋友；其展览一拖再拖，“becoming durational art”
relations.anchor: we’d finally go see Kurt’s show

relations.relation: 没有把她逐出家门，但也不真正容忍她；偶有联系，已数周没有她的消息
relations.anchor: they hadn’t disowned her but they didn’t really tolerate her either

relations.relation: Renata 口中的 “that piece of shit bastard”，被她认定把 Star 打得半死弃之不顾
relations.anchor: he must have left her for dead

relations.relation: 随 Bianca 来守夜念玫瑰经的 “beautiful friends”
relations.anchor: Her beautiful friends worked the beads with their fingers

numbers.value: 失踪时长 About a week, we think. At least four days.
numbers.anchor: About a week, we think. At least four days.

numbers.value: 家人无消息的时长 in weeks

年份模糊指涉 years ago（叙述者曾找生病的母亲）
numbers.anchor: years ago, I had to find my mother when she was sick

turning_point.statement: 本章转折点：Claude 在电话里告诉 Renata，St. Vincent’s 七楼有一名符合 Star 外貌描述、被打得很惨且无法辨认、尚不能开口的女子（此前她先被送进急诊室后被转出）——失踪的 Star 由此变成“被丢下等死的伤者”，Renata 从无结果的寻找转入赶赴医院。
turning_point.anchor: We have someone who fits your friend’s description on seven.
